comments.text: Hi everyone, I'm Elle, and I work on product and go-to-market for zCAD. The question we kept coming back to: where is this model going to live? If it lives in a game, a render or a virtual world, a mesh is the right answer, and AI 3D tools already do it well. If it has to work in the physical world, fit another part, take a screw, get printed or machined, it needs CAD: real dimensions, solid geometry, parts that mate. zCAD. AI generates that from a prompt, and exports STEP into the tool you already use.On the product side, a few choices are deliberate. Even the free plan exports STEP, because a part you can't take into your own tools isn't really yours. We turn down figurine requests, because sculpted, organic shapes are what mesh does best, even when you print them. And it doesn't make engineering calls for you. Tolerances and materials stay with you. On the go-to-market side, I'll be honest: we're still learning who needs this most. Makers who 3D print, indie hardware designers, engineers who live in CAD all day? That's a big part of why we're here. Try it on something that has to work in the real world, and tell us who you are and where it breaks.

comments.text: Hi everyone, I'm Martín, an indie macOS developer (I also make Tangible). I built Many Displays because my two identical LG 4K monitors swapped places after every sleep, and every window piled up on one of them. macOS can't tell identical monitors apart because many ship with the same EDID serial, and DisplayPort monitors "disconnect" when the Mac sleeps. Many Displays keeps one layout per combination of displays. It tells identical monitors apart by system UUID and then by physical port, fixes the arrangement, resolution, rotation and HDR first, and then puts every window back by itself. It reads the window server's list (about 20 ms for hundreds of windows) instead of asking every app through Accessibility, so a busy app never stalls it. No network, no analytics, and the source is on GitHub under the FSL (MIT after two years). It's $19 one-time with a year of updates, after a 14-day trial with no account. مسئله و راه‌حل:
توسعه‌دهندگان ایجنت‌های هوش مصنوعی برای انجام کارهای پیچیده به ابزارهای متعددی نیاز دارند، اما مدیریت ده‌ها کلید API و خرید اشتراک‌های مجزا اصطکاک بسیار بالایی ایجاد می‌کند. Composio Instant با حذف نیاز به ثبت‌نام‌های متعدد، مدل «پرداخت بر اساس مصرف» را برای ایجنت‌ها فراهم می‌کند تا بتوانند به صورت خودکار هزینه ابزارهای مورد نیاز خود را بپردازند.

معماری و تکنولوژی:
این پلتفرم از یک لایه پروکسی یکپارچه و مدیریت متمرکز اعتبار استفاده می‌کند. ایجنت‌ها از طریق یک SDK واحد یا واسط API به بیش از هزار ابزار متصل شده و احراز هویت و تسویه مالی زیرپوستی توسط خود پلتفرم مدیریت می‌شود.

مدل درآمدی:
درآمد اصلی از طریق افزودن درصد مشخصی کارمزد بر روی مصرف واقعی APIها و فروش بسته‌های اعتبار شارژی تامین می‌شود.

نقاط قوت:
حذف کامل اصطکاک راه‌اندازی، عدم نیاز به مدیریت کلیدهای API متعدد و تسهیل خودکارسازی امور توسط ایجنت‌ها.

نقاط ضعف:
نگرانی کاربران از هزینه‌کرد بی‌رویه ایجنت‌ها در صورت بروز باگ یا حلقه‌های بی‌نهایت، و نیاز به شفاف‌سازی قیمت‌گذاری در مقایسه با ابزارهای مجزا.

نکته طلایی برای ایران:
در ایران به دلیل عدم دسترسی مستقیم به کارت‌های credit بین‌المللی، ایجاد یک «پلتفرم واسط ریالی» که اعتبار APIها را یکجا خریداری کرده و با دریافت ریال، دسترسی یکپارچه به صدها ابزار AI را برای توسعه‌دهندگان ایرانی فراهم کند، یک فرصت فوق‌العاده سودآور با تقاضای بسیار بالا است.

week.tagline: AI 3D that creates real parts, not just shapes
week.description: zCAD. AI is an AI-native platform for generating parametric 3D models, built for designers, makers and engineers. Describe a part or assembly in plain language, and zCAD. AI generates an editable, dimension-driven 3D model built on real CAD geometry, not a static mesh. • Complete assemblies from a single prompt, with mates between parts • Refine in plain language, or edit dimensions in a browser-based CAD editor • Export to STEP for use in any CAD tool

comments.text: Hi everyone, I'm Elle, and I work on product and go-to-market for zCAD. The question we kept coming back to: where is this model going to live? If it lives in a game, a render or a virtual world, a mesh is the right answer, and AI 3D tools already do it well. If it has to work in the physical world, fit another part, take a screw, get printed or machined, it needs CAD: real dimensions, solid geometry, parts that mate. zCAD. AI generates that from a prompt, and exports STEP into the tool you already use.On the product side, a few choices are deliberate. Even the free plan exports STEP, because a part you can't take into your own tools isn't really yours. We turn down figurine requests, because sculpted, organic shapes are what mesh does best, even when you print them. And it doesn't make engineering calls for you. Tolerances and materials stay with you. On the go-to-market side, I'll be honest: we're still learning who needs this most. Makers who 3D print, indie hardware designers, engineers who live in CAD all day? That's a big part of why we're here. Try it on something that has to work in the real world, and tell us who you are and where it breaks.

Hi Product Hunt,I'm Arick, co-founder and CEO of BAND. Today we're launching BAND for Developers.If you run more than one coding agent, you know the pattern. Each agent is fast on its own, but they can't talk to each other, so you become the go-between. You copy context from one session into the next, tell the test agent what the refactor agent just changed, and find out an hour later that two agents made opposite assumptions about the same interface. More agents should mean more work done. Instead, a lot of it turns into more coordination for you.Most multi-agent dev tools today give you a better dispatch board. You assign tasks, agents run in parallel, you review what comes back. That helps with throughput, but every handoff still goes through a human.BAND for Developers lets the agents work it out between themselves:- Connect the agents you already run. Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot and OpenCode agents join shared rooms across machines. You keep your IDE, your terminal and your workflow.- Agents collaborate directly. They message each other, delegate, review each other's work and unblock one another. They can pull in a teammate's agent when the work needs it. Plans, decisions and work state live in the room rather than inside one session, so they survive when a session ends.- You step in when it matters. You keep working from the terminal. BAND desktop shows what's moving, what's blocked and which agent is waiting on you. Open the room, answer the question or redirect the agent, then step back out while the rest of the work keeps going.The difference is that the agents aren't only running side by side. They coordinate while the work is happening, so many of the handoffs you'd normally do yourself happen without you. And you don't have to move your whole team onto one vendor's agents to get there.BAND desktop is free. Download it at band.ai/use-cases/band-desktop. week.name: MOVO AI
week.tagline: The world's first long-form video agent for mobile
week.description: MOVO AI is the world’s first AI video agent for long-form creation that works right from your phone. It also works on the web. Shoot, upload, or start with an idea, then tell MOVO AI what you want. MOVO plans, creates, refines, keeps characters and scenes consistent, and brings the whole video together. Lock your phone and MOVO keeps working. Come back to review or make changes through chat. No prompt gymnastics. No canvas-heavy workflows. No manual clip stitching.

comments.text: Hi Product Hunt 👋I’m one of the makers behind MOVO AI—the world’s first long-form video agent on your mobile.My mother is a small creator who manages several social media accounts, and my father is her loyal cameraman. They are both over 60, but they still spend hours filming, editing, posting, and proudly watching every new like and follower.They make little, if any, money from it. But social media gives them something real: an audience, confidence, and the feeling that their stories are being seen.At the same time, I watched more founders around me become creators. They recorded videos between meetings, explained their ideas to customers, and built influence around themselves and their products.I was different. I was an introverted engineer who began working in AI while completing my graduate degree at Carnegie Mellon University. I had ideas, but I didn’t understand camera movements, editing, or how to look natural on camera. Even with the newest iPhone, I often didn’t know where to begin.My parents showed me how meaningful it could be to share your life. The founders around me showed me how necessary video was becoming. Together, they made me feel like I was being left behind by an era I was helping to build.That gap became the reason we built MOVO AI.What is MOVO?MOVO turns an idea into a complete long-form video through one continuous conversation.Start with a rough thought, script, reference, or a few assets. MOVO helps structure the story, establish the characters and visual direction, generate scenes, respond to feedback, and compose everything into a cohesive video.You don’t need to know the technical name of every shot or write a complex prompt for each scene. You can simply talk to MOVO as you would talk to a director, creative partner, or friend.Internally, we describe it as “Codex for video”: you direct what you want to create without writing every underlying instruction yourself.What surprised usWe initially thought eliminating prompt gymnastics would mainly help beginners. Professional AI creators already knew how to write sophisticated prompts, select models, and manage complicated workflows.We underestimated how much professionals would value this approach too.They embraced it not because they couldn’t write prompts, but because they wanted to focus their attention on what matters more: story, structure, pacing, characters, and emotion.Conversations with accomplished professors and screenwriters at USC’s School of Cinematic Arts reinforced this belief. Models and production tools will keep changing, but storytelling remains the foundation.We realized that agentic creation is not simply an easier mode for beginners. It may be a more universal creative interface: accessible enough for a first-time creator, yet powerful enough to free professionals from repetitive production work.Why mobile mattersOnce creation becomes conversational, it no longer needs to live inside a desktop canvas.A founder can start a product video before the next meeting. A store owner can review an advertisement from behind the counter. A parent can develop a family story in the park. A filmmaker can approve scenes while moving between locations. A hiker can capture an idea at the summit before the inspiration disappears.You might describe an idea over breakfast, approve the storyboard on the train, review generated scenes after work, and refine the ending before bed.MOVO continues working asynchronously, so you don’t need to babysit every generation. Creation can move with your life instead of requiring your life to stop.From one video to an ongoing worldWithin the same project, you can begin Episodes 2, 3, and 4 in new sessions without re-entering the same characters, products, locations, and creative direction.MOVO carries that context forward, helping you develop an ongoing world rather than a collection of disconnected clips.What we’d love you to testWe would especially value feedback on three things:Does talking to MOVO feel like working with a useful director or creative partner?Can you meaningfully develop a video on mobile without supervising every step?How well does MOVO preserve your creative world across multiple episodes?AI video still has many unsolved problems, and MOVO is still evolving. We want to hear where it understands your direction, where it surprises you, and where it falls short.Our goal is not to replace human creativity. It is to close the gap between having a story and being able to show it.Anyone with a story should be able to make it move—wherever life takes them.Your idea. Moved by MOVO. 🎬

در حال حاضر مدل درآمدی مستقیم ندارد و به عنوان یک پروژه جامعه‌محور (Community-driven) اجرا شده است؛ اما پتانسیل جذب اسپانسرشیپ شرکتی، ارائه خدمات کاریابی تخصصی (Recruitment) و فروش ابزارهای جانبی را دارد.

۱. بازاریابی ویروسی فوق‌العاده از طریق راهبرد ساخت شفاف و زنده (Building in Public).
